notes.title: New Year Update "Loop Mode"!
notes.notes:
A new mode was added to the startup dialog: "Loop Mode"
This mode allows you to skip the results screen displayed after every song, and play the dance sequence on repeat.
The dance can be ended by pressing the escape key

notes.title: New Update December 20, 2016
notes.notes:
We've made another small update to the game - for the free version, there's now a button on the title screen labeled "DLC" that takes you straight to the store page for the Encore Pack DLC. If you already have the DLC installed, you won't see the button!
Thanks, and we hope you continue to enjoy Time Leap Paradise SUPER LIVE!
